cohort: The study included primigravidas (first-time pregnant women) at or beyond 20 weeks of gestation with blood pressure >=140/90 mm Hg.
finding: Women with gestational hypertension with proteinuria were significantly more likely to deliver preterm infants compared to women with gestational hypertension without proteinuria.
gest_age: Inclusion criteria: >= 20th weeks of gestation; mean gestational age in the exposed group was 36.89 +/- 4.04 weeks and in the non-exposed group 37.75 +/- 3.428 weeks.
